qa.pageTurn: All page-level particle motion has been retired. The outgoing snapshot is mapped onto a deterministic triangle mesh: its lower portion compresses upward into diagonal creases and a curled ridge while the next page remains flat underneath. Scroll progress directly controls the fold, reverse scrolling restores the same geometry, and mobile keeps a readable native long-page fallback
